digest.component_or_area: CI gate steps in GitHub Actions workflow
propositions: Multiple gate steps in _build-and-test.yml and gerrit-verify.yaml run repo scripts without if-present guards, causing hard CI failures when the scripts are absent from checked-out change trees.
Gerrit's Verified lane uses the workflow definition from the target branch but checks out the change's tree, causing gate steps added to main to fail against open changes with older base commits.
Running unguarded gate step commands in directories without the scripts exits with exit code 2 (file not found), producing false Verified -1 verdicts indistinguishable from real gate violations.
All 11 enumerated unguarded steps must be wrapped with if-present guards that skip with a log line when the script is absent from the tree.
A structural guard must be added to fail the build when any Gerrit patchset-lane workflow step runs a repo script without an if-present guard, preventing future instances of this defect class.
